name: Nagiwa Yoriko
source:
Transfer student entering the 2nd year student at Cherry Tree High.
Sara decided to transfer schools and move to Cherry Tree Town to better understand herself and what she wants to do in life.
She has a dog called Roland and together they move into Unity Dormitory.
Sara is kind, but somewhat demure and not the out-going type.
